evidence_citation_locator_check.name: evidence_citation_locator_check
evidence_citation_locator_check.value: btrim("evidence_citations"."locator") <> '' and ("evidence_citations"."locator_precision" = 'exact' or ("evidence_citations"."precision_explanation" is not null and btrim("evidence_citations"."precision_explanation") <> ''))

office_tenure_dates_check.name: office_tenure_dates_check
office_tenure_dates_check.value: "office_tenures"."valid_to" is null or "office_tenures"."valid_from" is null or "office_tenures"."valid_to" >= "office_tenures"."valid_from"

party_affiliation_dates_check.name: party_affiliation_dates_check
party_affiliation_dates_check.value: "party_affiliations"."valid_to" is null or "party_affiliations"."valid_from" is null or "party_affiliations"."valid_to" >= "party_affiliations"."valid_from"

person_name_dates_check.name: person_name_dates_check
person_name_dates_check.value: "person_names"."valid_to" is null or "person_names"."valid_from" is null or "person_names"."valid_to" >= "person_names"."valid_from"

political_status_item_one_reference_chec.name: political_status_item_one_reference_check
political_status_item_one_reference_chec.value: ((case when "political_status_items"."party_affiliation_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) + (case when "political_status_items"."office_tenure_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) + (case when "political_status_items"."candidacy_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)) = 1

public_claim_statement_dates_check.name: public_claim_statement_dates_check
public_claim_statement_dates_check.value: "public_claims"."statement_to" is null or "public_claims"."statement_from" is null or "public_claims"."statement_to" >= "public_claims"."statement_from"

source_version_predecessor_check.name: source_version_predecessor_check
source_version_predecessor_check.value: ("source_versions"."change_type" = 'original' and "source_versions"."previous_version_id" is null and "source_versions"."change_summary" is null) or ("source_versions"."change_type" <> 'original' and "source_versions"."previous_version_id" is not null and "source_versions"."change_summary" is not null)
